disposition_reason: The complete original PhysioP300 Table 4 comparison panel is the selected same-task scope. Its published scores are recoverable, but the released preprocessing and training scripts disagree about subject membership and epoch boundaries, and the reporting/selection reduction is not sufficiently reconciled for a calibrated comparison. The broader S8 programme is preserved as history, without requiring unrelated downstream datasets for a PhysioP300 win.

source_paper.title: EEGPT: Pretrained Transformer for Universal and Reliable Representation of EEG Signals

evidence.locator: Table 4, PhysioP300/Ours row; section 3.2; Appendix C.2.5 and D
evidence.supports: Binary P300 classification, published result, LOSO configuration, preprocessing description, three repetitions, and binary AUROC monitor.
Eight-subject preparation list, -0.1 to 2 second epoch, low-pass/resampling, event target labels, and output naming that restarts i in each recording.
58-channel encoder route, class-1 probabilities, optimizer restricted to scaling/probes, nine subject LOSO loop, and per-epoch held-out subject validation.
Binary metrics delegation to PyHealth, threshold convention, and single-class fallback; downstream library/version still requires pinning.
Original public ERP BCI release, annotated EEG/EOG matrix-speller recordings and provider description of ten participants.

evidence.locator: Pretrained Models, lines 24-34; Other Downstream Tasks, lines 55-64
evidence.supports: Official EEG_large checkpoint route and downstream entrypoint family; no verified checkpoint digest or empirical rerun supplied by this audit.

target.description: Predict whether a matrix-speller stimulus contains the attended character from its EEG event epoch. Current scope is the complete original PhysioP300 Table 4 panel, including all source subjects, EEGPT and original BENDR/BIOT/LaBraM controls, and all three reported metrics.

dataset.description: PhysioNet ERP-based Brain-Computer Interface recordings, erpbci version 1.0.0 (10.13026/C2101S). No substitute P300 corpus or synthetic episodes.

cohort.description: Paper describes nine subjects after excluding 8, 10, and 12. Probe uses [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,9,11], but converter uses [2,3,4,5,6,7,9,11]; provider describes ten participants. Recover original recording/person identity and exclusion manifest.

split.description: LOSO is documented and the probe holds out each of nine subject suffixes, but original cohort/event-support and assessment/selection semantics remain unqualified. The held-out subject is validated every epoch; the source does not identify how those values produce the reported result. A protocol-equivalent rerun may use declared new randomness while preserving the original LOSO rules and evaluation population.

inputs.description: Author route selects 58 EEG channels, applies a pretrained frozen encoder and trains channel scales plus linear probes. The exact released checkpoint, pretraining ancestry, exposure parity, and historical event support require qualification. No extra EOG, test labels, or easier channel condition may be introduced.

preprocessing.description: Paper specifies a 2-second epoch from -0.7 seconds, 120 Hz low-pass and 256 Hz. Converter instead epochs -0.1 to 2 seconds, scales volts to mV and restarts output names i.subN for each recording; this can overwrite events. Probe mean-centers across channels before selecting 58. Recover the actual paper preparation before choosing any repair.

metric.description: Primary source component metric is AUROC, higher better: probability that a target event receives a higher class-1 score than a nontarget, with half credit for ties. Probe concatenates all validation-epoch scores before binary metrics. Report BAC and Cohen kappa too; single-class support cannot be silently accepted as a valid AUROC.

aggregation.description: Paper reports three experiment repetitions and SD. Subject weighting, selected epoch and fold-to-run reduction require reconciliation. Reproducing the source-supported stochastic protocol with recorded new seeds is legitimate; the historical seed archive is not mandatory. Do not pool repeated predictions or treat epochs as independent people.

comparison.primary_metric: PhysioP300 Table 4 AUROC with complete source comparison panel and BAC/Cohen kappa reporting

published_baseline.description: Table 4 PhysioP300 EEGPT: AUROC 0.7168 +/- 0.0051, BAC 0.6502 +/- 0.0063, kappa 0.2999 +/- 0.0139. Original controls (BAC, kappa, AUROC): BENDR (0.6114, 0.2227, 0.6588), BIOT (0.5485, 0.0968, 0.5308), LaBraM (0.6477, 0.2935, 0.7068). These are published results, not local reruns or current SOTA.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No qualified author rerun. Official preparation/probe/checkpoint routes exist, but unresolved source discrepancies prevent treating their literal or repaired execution as calibrated evidence. A source-supported protocol-equivalent stochastic rerun may use recorded new seeds and a justified numerical calibration tolerance.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful P300 AUROC gain must be justified before evaluation using the recovered task and measurement variability. Neither the reported run SD nor the difference to LaBraM is an automatic superiority margin.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired subject-level inference after exact support and historical aggregation are recovered; retain all recordings/events and repeated fits within each participant, and report training-run variation separately. No confidence threshold or bootstrap count is claimed as source-specified.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Biological participant; events, repeated flashes, folds sharing training subjects, and seeds are dependent or nested observations.
uncertainty.rationale: Nine nominal LOSO participants and three repeated experiments do not supply independent event-level replicates; identity conflicts and shared fitting require explicit inferential assumptions.

paper_win_requires: Evaluate the complete original PhysioP300 Table 4 task: all source subjects under LOSO, original EEGPT and BENDR/BIOT/LaBraM control conditions, and AUROC/BAC/Cohen kappa reporting. Unrelated S8 downstream tasks are not prerequisites for this selected panel win.

Resolve subject/recording/event support, epoch boundaries, scoring reduction, checkpoint and exposure protocol. Establish author-baseline calibration on the original population; protocol-equivalent stochastic reruns with recorded new seeds and justified calibration tolerance are valid.

Freeze candidate procedure, preprocessing and selection before final scoring; use training/development feedback during iteration, disclose historical public-test exposure, and pair candidate/reference comparisons on the same evaluated support.

Exceed the source EEGPT result under the original task with a justified predeclared effect and valid paired uncertainty rule, while retaining the complete source panel and reporting all original metrics and failures.

Keep changed preprocessing without source-parity evidence, new split rules, reduced cohorts and new adaptation regimes as separately labelled extensions. Local controls and successful reproduction alone cannot substitute for the published comparison.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was audited. The 2024 source result is distinct from any later method or benchmark.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive until preparation/protocol reconciliation. Once admitted, candidates may iterate on permitted original training/development subjects using fixed feedback and identical pretrained access; assessment metrics cannot guide subsequent revisions. Preserve the complete PhysioP300 panel and source control conditions.
episode.candidate_freeze: Commit the method, data/preprocessing manifest, pretrained state identity, adaptation/search procedure, stopping and selection rule, metric reduction, and resource/access limits before protected evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate all original PhysioP300 LOSO subjects and source repetition protocol against calibrated author/control reruns, allowing declared protocol-equivalent new randomness. Report the complete Table 4 metric panel and published scores separately. Preserve full S8 materials as history; unrelated datasets are outside this selected same-task win.
episode.baseline_policy: Use source-paper EEGPT as the success comparator. Author rerun is separately identified and must first calibrate against the published row. EEGNet, spectral ridge, fine-tuned variants and prospectively selected control mixtures remain secondary controls, never a replacement source-paper score.

blocking_issues: Paper and converter disagree on epoch length/onset; source-equivalent preparation has not been established.
Eight-subject converter and nine-subject probe conflict; biological identities, recordings and exclusions require reconciliation.
Converter output names may overwrite across recordings; complete source event support must be established.
The reporting epoch/selection semantics and fold-to-run reduction need source-supported reconciliation; exact historical seeds are not required for a documented protocol-equivalent rerun.
Checkpoint/pretraining exposure parity, calibrated author and original-control reruns, and an admitted working evaluator remain absent.
Meaningful effect, uncertainty assumptions, concrete access/resource budgets and protected evaluation episode remain unqualified.

legacy.notes: Preserve the original P300 registration and complete S8 source/inspection programme, including seven downstream datasets, reconstruction and prospective designs. Current success concerns the complete original PhysioP300 Table 4 panel; it neither requires unrelated S8 tasks nor claims a whole-programme win. No scientific run was made in this overhaul.
